kpis.name: Firm AUM
kpis.dbQuery:
SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_aum
FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account a
    ON p.financial_account_id = a.financial_account_id
WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
)
  AND a.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND a.is_active = 1

kpis.name: Organic Growth Rate
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date)
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

),

beginning_aum AS (

    SELECT
        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
            SELECT snapshot_date
            FROM beginning_snapshot
          )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

),

net_new_assets AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN
                    ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS nna

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.transactions t

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN bs.start_date
              AND ls.end_date

      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

)

SELECT

    ROUND(nna.nna,2) AS net_new_assets,

    ROUND(ba.beginning_aum,2) AS beginning_aum,

    ROUND(
        (
            nna.nna /
            NULLIF(ba.beginning_aum,0)
        )
        *
        (12.0 / MONTH(ls.end_date))
        * 100,
        2
    ) AS organic_growth_rate

FROM net_new_assets nna

CROSS JOIN beginning_aum ba
CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls;

kpis.name: Est. Annual Revenue
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions

),
current_year_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(fc.gross_comm) AS ytd_revenue,
        MONTH(MAX(fc.broker_month)) AS completed_months
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.fa_commission fc
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON fc.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot lm
    WHERE fc.broker_month BETWEEN
          DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date)
          AND lm.latest_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator='O'
      AND fa.is_active=1
),

previous_year_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(fc.gross_comm) AS ytd_revenue
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.fa_commission fc
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON fc.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN current_year_revenue c
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot lm
    WHERE fc.broker_month BETWEEN
        ADD_MONTHS(
            DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date),
            -12
        )
        AND
        ADD_MONTHS(
            ADD_MONTHS(
                DATE_TRUNC('year', lm.latest_date),
                -12
            ),
            c.completed_months
        ) - 1
      AND fa.account_status_indicator='O'
      AND fa.is_active=1

)
SELECT

    ROUND(
        c.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months,
        2
    ) AS estimated_annual_revenue,

    ROUND(
        p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months,
        2
    ) AS previous_estimated_revenue,

    ROUND(
        (
            (c.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months) - (p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months)
        )/
        NULLIF((p.ytd_revenue * 12 / c.completed_months),0) * 100, 2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct

FROM current_year_revenue c

CROSS JOIN previous_year_revenue p;

kpis.name: Client Retention
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions

),

beginning_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', end_date)
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

),

beginning_aum AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = bs.start_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

),

outflows AS (

    SELECT

        SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS outflow_amount

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.transactions t

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN bs.start_date
              AND ls.end_date

      AND t.transaction_code IN
            (
                'DISTRIBUTION',
                'TRANSFER_OUT',
                'SFF',
                'PCC'
            )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

)

SELECT

    ROUND(ba.beginning_aum,2) AS beginning_aum,

    ROUND(COALESCE(o.outflow_amount,0),2) AS outflows,

    ROUND(

        (
            ba.beginning_aum
            -
            COALESCE(o.outflow_amount,0)
        )
        /
        NULLIF(ba.beginning_aum,0)
        * 100,

        2

    ) AS client_retention_rate

FROM beginning_aum ba

CROSS JOIN outflows o;

kpis.name: Households
kpis.dbQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hd.house_hold_name) AS household_count
FROM wealth_pulse.gold.household_details hd
JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
    ON hd.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
WHERE fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
  AND fa.is_active = 1

kpis.name: High Risk Households
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
account_base AS (
    SELECT
        ac.financial_account_id,
        ac.account_number,
        h.house_hold_name,
        (COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth, 0) + COALESCE(ac.cash_available, 0)) AS account_aum,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth, 0) + COALESCE(ac.cash_available, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ac.cash_available * 100.0 / (COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth, 0) + COALESCE(ac.cash_available, 0))
        END AS cash_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.account_summary ac
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.household_details h
        ON ac.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
),
account_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        p.financial_account_id,
        MAX(ABS(p.amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(ab.account_aum, 0)) AS concentration_pct
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN account_base ab
        ON p.financial_account_id = ab.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
    GROUP BY p.financial_account_id
),
account_drift AS (
    SELECT
        ab.financial_account_id,
        ABS(
            (ac.total_equity * 100.0 / NULLIF((COALESCE(ac.trade_date_net_worth, 0) + COALESCE(ac.cash_available, 0)), 0))
            - dmp.target_equity_pct
        ) AS drift_pct
    FROM account_base ab
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.account_summary ac
        ON ab.financial_account_id = ac.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse_insigneo_model.silver.account_model_mapping amm
        ON ab.account_number = amm.account_number
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.dim_model_portfolio dmp
        ON amm.model_id = dmp.model_id
),
household_risk AS (
    SELECT
        ab.house_hold_name,
        MAX(COALESCE(cc.concentration_pct, 0)) AS concentration_risk,
        SUM(COALESCE(ad.drift_pct, 0) * ab.account_aum) / NULLIF(SUM(ab.account_aum), 0) AS drift_risk,
        SUM(ab.cash_pct * ab.account_aum) / NULLIF(SUM(ab.account_aum), 0) AS cash_risk
    FROM account_base ab
    LEFT JOIN account_concentration cc
        ON ab.financial_account_id = cc.financial_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_drift ad
        ON ab.financial_account_id = ad.financial_account_id
    GROUP BY ab.house_hold_name
),
household_score AS (
    SELECT
        house_hold_name,
        (
            (CASE WHEN concentration_risk > 10 THEN 100 ELSE concentration_risk * 10 END)
            + (CASE WHEN drift_risk > 8 THEN 100 ELSE drift_risk * 12.5 END)
            + (CASE WHEN cash_risk > 10 THEN 100 ELSE cash_risk * 10 END)
        ) / 3 AS risk_score
    FROM household_risk
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_risk_households
FROM household_score
WHERE risk_score >= 70

kpis.name: Avg YTD Return
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),

/* Latest Household AUM */
household_aum AS (
    SELECT
        h.house_hold_name,
        SUM(p.amount) AS aum
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.household_details h
        ON p.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot l
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = l.max_snapshot_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        h.house_hold_name
),

/* Beginning Household AUM */
beginning_household_aum AS (
    SELECT
        h.house_hold_name,
        SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.household_details h
        ON p.financial_account_id = h.financial_account_id
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
        FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
        WHERE snapshot_date < DATE_TRUNC(
            'year',
            (SELECT max_snapshot_date FROM latest_snapshot)
        )
    )
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        h.house_hold_name
),

/* Household YTD Return */
household_ytd_return AS (
    SELECT
        ha.house_hold_name,
        (
            (ha.aum - COALESCE(b.beginning_aum,0))
            / NULLIF(b.beginning_aum,0)
        ) * 100 AS ytd_return
    FROM household_aum ha
    LEFT JOIN beginning_household_aum b
        ON ha.house_hold_name = b.house_hold_name
)

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(ytd_return), 2) AS avg_household_ytd_return_pct
FROM household_ytd_return
WHERE ytd_return IS NOT NULL;

kpis.name: Top AUM Growth
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH snapshot_refs AS (

    SELECT

        (
            SELECT MAX(snapshot_date)
            FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
        ) AS current_snapshot,

        (
            SELECT MIN(snapshot_date)
            FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
        ) AS prior_snapshot

),

current_aum AS (

    SELECT

        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(p.amount) AS current_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN snapshot_refs s

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = s.current_snapshot
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        fa.investment_professional_number

),

prior_aum AS (

    SELECT

        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(p.amount) AS prior_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p

    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    CROSS JOIN snapshot_refs s

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = s.prior_snapshot
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY
        fa.investment_professional_number

),

advisor_growth AS (

    SELECT

        c.investment_professional_number,

        c.current_aum,

        COALESCE(p.prior_aum,0) AS prior_aum,

        ROUND(
            (
                (c.current_aum - p.prior_aum)
                /
                NULLIF(p.prior_aum,0)
            ) * 100,
            2
        ) AS growth_pct

    FROM current_aum c

    LEFT JOIN prior_aum p
        ON c.investment_professional_number = p.investment_professional_number

)

SELECT

    fa.rep_id AS advisor_id,

    fa.record_assigned_name AS advisor_name,

    ROUND(ag.current_aum,2) AS current_aum,

    ag.growth_pct

FROM advisor_growth ag

JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_advisor fa
    ON ag.investment_professional_number = fa.rep_id

WHERE ag.growth_pct IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY
    growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST,
    current_aum DESC

LIMIT 1;

kpis.name: Most Net New Money
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (

    SELECT
        MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions

),

date_filter AS (

    SELECT
        end_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', end_date) AS start_date
    FROM latest_snapshot

),

advisor_nnm AS (

    SELECT
        fa.investment_professional_number,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('CONTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_IN','RFF','CSR')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        -
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.transaction_code IN ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
                THEN ABS(t.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS net_new_money

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.transactions t

    INNER JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id

    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE)
          BETWEEN (SELECT start_date FROM date_filter)
              AND (SELECT end_date FROM date_filter)
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1

    GROUP BY fa.investment_professional_number

),

advisor_aum AS (

    SELECT
        p.investment_professional_number,
        SUM(p.amount) AS current_aum

    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p

    WHERE p.snapshot_date = (
        SELECT end_date
        FROM latest_snapshot
    )

    GROUP BY p.investment_professional_number

)

SELECT

    fa.rep_id as investment_professional_number,
    fa.record_assigned_name as advisor_name,

    ROUND(n.net_new_money,2) AS net_new_money,

    ROUND(a.current_aum,2) AS current_aum,

    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN a.current_aum > 0
            THEN (n.net_new_money / a.current_aum) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS net_new_money_pct

FROM advisor_nnm n

JOIN advisor_aum a
    ON n.investment_professional_number = a.investment_professional_number

JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_advisor fa
    ON n.investment_professional_number = fa.rep_id

ORDER BY net_new_money_pct DESC, current_aum DESC

LIMIT 1;

kpis.name: Best Client Retention
kpis.dbQuery:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS end_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
),
beginning_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS start_date
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions
    WHERE snapshot_date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', end_date) FROM latest_snapshot)
),
beginning_aum AS (
    SELECT fa.investment_professional_number, SUM(p.amount) AS beginning_aum
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.positions p
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON p.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs
    WHERE p.snapshot_date = bs.start_date
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY fa.investment_professional_number
),
outflows AS (
    SELECT fa.investment_professional_number, SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS outflow_amount
    FROM wealth_pulse.gold.transactions t
    JOIN wealth_pulse.gold.financial_account fa
        ON t.financial_account_id = fa.financial_account_id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    CROSS JOIN beginning_snapshot bs
    WHERE CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE) BETWEEN bs.start_date AND ls.end_date
      AND t.transaction_code IN ('DISTRIBUTION','TRANSFER_OUT','SFF','PCC')
      AND fa.account_status_indicator = 'O'
      AND fa.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY fa.investment_professional_number
)
SELECT
    ROUND(MAX(
        (ba.beginning_aum - COALESCE(o.outflow_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(ba.beginning_aum, 0) * 100
    ), 2) AS best_client_retention_rate
FROM beginning_aum ba
LEFT JOIN outflows o
    ON ba.investment_professional_number = o.investment_professional_number
